claims.claim: The proposal requests $298,250, stated as 1,193,000 ADA, to support Technical Steering Committee activities for 12 months.
WP 1 funds attendance of technical experts at major ecosystem events and commissioning of technical reports.
WP 2 funds the Parameter Committee, CIP editors, and Hard Fork Working Group.

WP 3 funds establishment of a pilot independent technical review programme launching in 2027 with conflict-of-interest provisions, published recusals, and open reviewer selection against documented criteria.
Technical workshops, the Security Council, and the Bug Bounty Programme are funded separately through the main Intersect budget and are not included in this request.
All expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds returned to the Cardano treasury.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.

The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and includes references to voting documentation, audited results, and an audit report.
The requested amount does not at time of submission, alone or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, role-based sign-offs, external oversight entities, audit references, and a public dashboard for tracking funds.

summary: The document presents a 1,193,000 ADA Intersect-submitted treasury request for 12 months of TSC support, with three budgeted work packages, external references for the budget process and smart-contract tooling, and asserted commitments around accounting, unspent-fund return, and audit oversight.
